model_note: DC OPF, single slack, POI as one extra load variable; N-1 = each branch outaged once. MW at the POI bus.
mapping: case_load_h = case_reference * (observed_load_h / observed_mean); shape measured, level held at the case reference
feasibility_rule: an hour is evaluable iff 1036.0 <= case_load <= 3405.0; other hours are reported with evaluable=false, never dropped
